<rules>
Decide who is most likely the impostor and commit to it. Reason only from your memory and the transcript above — assume no roles, kills, or vents you did not witness. Speak your opening as 2-3 short sentences in "free_text", then stop: report what you saw honestly, then either point at ONE living player with a concrete detail or say you are not sure yet.
A witnessed vent is the single strongest fact this game produces — speak it FIRST, at this meeting, even if it happened many ticks ago and even if you already said it at an earlier meeting: a held vent wins the game only once it is on the record. One exception, and only one: if the player you saw vent is already dead or ejected, that case is closed — say nothing about it and spend your turn on someone still in the game. If your memory contains one — a line like "- [tick 12] You witnessed p-3 vent in MEDBAY." — put it on the record as a structured "saw_vent" observation copied from that line exactly: {"type": "saw_vent", "tick": 12, "subject": "p-3", "room": "MEDBAY"}. Copying dozens of rows buries the signal and rambles past the output cap, which discards your whole turn.
Then either name your single best suspect in ONE "accusation" claim — the chain then passes to whoever you accuse — or, only if nothing you recorded points at anyone, write the word "unsure" in "free_text".   the "accusation" shown in the skeleton above — at most one. You are p-4, voting at an AiLibi meeting: a hidden impostor kills crewmates; the crew wins by voting the impostor out, the impostor by surviving until they equal or outnumber the crew. The discussion is over — cast one ejection ballot: name the one player you believe is the impostor, or SKIP if the evidence is too thin. The outcome is a deterministic tally over every ballot, so vote the conclusion you actually reach.
</persona>

<voice>
Your voice at this table: An expansive narrator who recounts the whole sequence as a flowing, scene-by-scene story. Sets the scene with vivid detail before reaching the point. Strings moments together with 'and then, and then'. Never gives the short version when a fuller telling is at hand.
Let that voice color HOW you speak — the wording of your "rationale_text" only; your target, confidence, and cited reason ids follow the evidence and the rules below, exactly as written.
</voice>

<memory>
## Your role: CREWMATE
## Tasks completed (global): 2 / 3

## Where you were:
- Your route (t = tick): CAFETERIA t0 -> EAST_HALL t1 -> ENGINEERING t2 -> STORAGE t3-9 -> ENGINEERING t10

## Recent observations (most salient first):
- [obs p-4:2:1] [tick 2] You saw p-2 in ENGINEERING (with p-3) (moved from EAST_HALL, last seen there at tick 1).
- [obs p-4:2:2] [tick 2] You saw p-3 in ENGINEERING (with p-2) (moved from EAST_HALL, last seen there at tick 1).
- [obs p-4:1:1] [tick 1] You saw p-2 in EAST_HALL (with p-3).
- [obs p-4:1:2] [tick 1] You saw p-3 in EAST_HALL (with p-2).
- [obs p-4:0:1] [tick 0] You saw every other player in CAFETERIA: p-1, p-2, p-3.
- [obs p-4:9:0] [tick 9] You completed fuel_reserves (you were in STORAGE).

</memory>

<transcript>
- [headless-seed-1049:meeting-0:turn-0] turn 0 (opening) — p-1
  saw:
  - tick 8: witnessed p-2 VENT in ADMIN (only the impostor can vent).
  - tick 8: p-1 places THEMSELVES in ADMIN (roll-call answer).
  claims:
  - accuses p-2 (1.00): Witnessed venting in Admin
  said: "Good evening, colleagues. I called this meeting because I witnessed p-2 vent in Admin at tick 8, which is conclusive evidence of their impostor status. I was present in the same room at that moment and saw them enter a vent."
- [headless-seed-1049:meeting-0:turn-1] turn 1 (reply) — p-2
  claims:
  - accuses p-1 (0.60): suspicious timing in ADMIN
  said: "I might have just been walking through Admin, but p-1's insistence on that specific moment feels... forced. Maybe they were trying to frame me because they were actually hiding in Admin at tick 8 themselves?"
- [headless-seed-1049:meeting-0:turn-2] turn 2 (opt_in) — p-4
  saw:
  - tick 8: p-4 places THEMSELVES in STORAGE (roll-call answer).
  - tick 9: task fuel_reserves in STORAGE.
  claims:
  - corroborates p-1 on tick 8: I was in Storage doing tasks, so I could not have been in Admin to frame p-2, validating p-1's witness account.
  - accuses p-2 (1.00): Witnessed venting in Admin is conclusive proof of impostor status.
  said: "And then, while I was locked away in Storage completing fuel reserves at tick 8, p-1 was in Admin watching p-2 vanish into a vent, and then, because only the impostor can vent, the case is closed and p-2 must go."
</transcript>

<contradictions>
Proof. Only an impostor can vent, so a witnessed vent here names one outright, and nothing said at this table outweighs it.
- [contra:vent_sighting:turn:headless-seed-1049:meeting-0:turn-0:obs:0|turn:headless-seed-1049:meeting-0:turn-0:obs:0] vent_sighting — p-1 witnessed p-2 vent in ADMIN at tick 8; venting is impostor-only, and the spoken observation matches the witness's own record. (subjects: p-2)
</contradictions>

<testimony_sources>
Who backed each name, and which of them saw it themselves. A voice is anyone who accused them tonight; an account is a voice who also described seeing them, with their own record bearing that description out. Someone who described seeing them but accused a different name, or who only backed another's charge, is not counted here — the evidence and transcript above carry what they said; a player nobody accused has no row. A sighting or a movement only places them somewhere, so a second such account corroborates a case only where what it describes bears on the death; a watched vent is the exception — it names an impostor outright, and the contradictions above are where it is read. Both are evidence and agreement at this table is often right, so read the split and price it — do not discount either half.
- p-2: 2 voices, 1 account — it started at [headless-seed-1049:meeting-0:turn-0]; p-1 described seeing them (venting in ADMIN at tick 8); p-4 named them without adding anything they saw. A contradiction above names them — read it there, in its own class.
- p-1: 1 voice, 0 accounts — it started at [headless-seed-1049:meeting-0:turn-1]; p-2 named them without adding anything they saw. No contradiction above names them.
  That charge came from someone `p-1` had already accused at [headless-seed-1049:meeting-0:turn-0] — an answer to a charge, not a second witness.
</testimony_sources>

<map>
Rooms and doors. Every door below is ONE tick of walking, so two players in rooms that share a door can be one tick apart:
- Admin (ADMIN): East Hallway (EAST_HALL), Upper Hall (UPPER_HALL), West Hallway (WEST_HALL)
- Cafeteria (CAFETERIA): East Hallway (EAST_HALL), Upper Hall (UPPER_HALL), West Hallway (WEST_HALL)
- East Hallway (EAST_HALL): Admin (ADMIN), Cafeteria (CAFETERIA), Engineering (ENGINEERING)
- Engineering (ENGINEERING): East Hallway (EAST_HALL), Reactor (REACTOR), Storage (STORAGE)
- Labs (LABS): MedBay (MEDBAY)
- MedBay (MEDBAY): Labs (LABS), West Hallway (WEST_HALL)
- Reactor (REACTOR): Engineering (ENGINEERING)
- Storage (STORAGE): Engineering (ENGINEERING)
- Upper Hall (UPPER_HALL): Admin (ADMIN), Cafeteria (CAFETERIA)
- West Hallway (WEST_HALL): Admin (ADMIN), Cafeteria (CAFETERIA), MedBay (MEDBAY)
Two accounts that name rooms one door apart at nearby ticks can BOTH be honest — that is one tick of walking, and a conflict over such a pair is thin. Two accounts that name far-apart rooms at the same tick cannot.
</map>

## Your suspicion of each player
- `p-1`: suspicion 0.45, trust 0.50 — built from: this meeting -0.05, carried prior +0.00
- `p-2`: suspicion 0.80, trust 0.50 — built from: this meeting +0.30, carried prior +0.00
Each row's "built from" split shows what made its number: "this meeting" is evidence that landed at this table (contradictions raised here, body proximity, a witnessed kill or vent, testimony), "carried prior" is what you brought in from earlier meetings. A row tagged "no contradiction; carried/soft only" has no hard evidence behind it anywhere — read that number as a lead to test against the transcript, not a finished case.

## Valid ejection targets
`p-1`, `p-2` — or "SKIP".
These are the ONLY names a ballot may carry. Every other player is already out of the game — ejected or dead — and naming one wastes your vote: an invalid target is struck to SKIP. Pick your target from this list, or SKIP.

## How to decide
Your maximum suspicion among the living ejection targets is **0.80**.
Read that as evidence, never as an instruction: when even your strongest living suspect is thin, SKIP is the sound call, and ejecting anyway must rest on evidence you can cite below, never on momentum. Your suspicion levels above are your own accumulated evidence from the whole game — trust them over meeting rhetoric. A suspect two independent witnesses place at the scene, or whose account one of the conflicts above contradicts, is a stronger case than one carried by a single voice. Remember the vent mechanic: an impostor vents BETWEEN rooms invisibly, so your own sightings of someone leaving or being elsewhere earlier do NOT clear them of a witnessed vent. If your strongest suspicion points at a row tagged OUT OF THE GAME, that case is already closed — the dead cannot be voted, so weigh only the LIVING targets and SKIP if none of them carries the case on its own. Every EJECT names its evidence: the transcript turn that convinced you (in "primary_reason_id"), or the [obs ...] memory line that did (in "primary_reason_observation_id") — a call you cannot source either way is a call to SKIP, and a SKIP needs no citation. Set "confidence" to your honest probability that the call is right, judged against the evidence you cite — a case you can barely source deserves a low number, and a case you cannot source at all deserves a SKIP. The numbers on this page are for your decision, not for your mouth: never quote a suspicion score or any other bookkeeping figure in "rationale_text" — say what you saw.

<output_format>
Respond with a single JSON object only. No commentary, no markdown, no code fences. It has EXACTLY these 7 keys, every one present and no others — the reason keys are "primary_reason_id" and "primary_reason_observation_id" (WITH the "_id" suffix), never "primary_reason":
{"voter": "p-4", "target": "<candidate id or SKIP>", "confidence": 0.8, "primary_reason_id": "headless-seed-1049:meeting-0:turn-2", "primary_reason_observation_id": null, "considered_alternatives": [], "rationale_text": "<one short sentence>"}
- "voter" must equal "p-4".
- "target" is "SKIP" or one living player other than yourself — never your own name; exactly one of `p-1`, `p-2`: any other name is an ejected or dead player and wastes your vote.
- "primary_reason_id" is a turn id copied VERBATIM from the bracketed transcript lines above — the skeleton shows [headless-seed-1049:meeting-0:turn-2], this meeting's latest turn; keep it only if that truly is the turn that convinced you, otherwise substitute the convincing turn's id. When a contradiction above broke your target's account, cite the turn that account was spoken in. Never invent or abbreviate an id — anything not in this meeting's transcript is nulled.
- "primary_reason_observation_id" carries the case your own memory makes: when the decisive evidence is a memory line above tagged like [obs p-4:12:0], copy that tag's id EXACTLY (e.g. "primary_reason_observation_id": "p-4:12:0") — an id that is not on one of YOUR OWN memory lines is nulled. Keep it null when a transcript turn already carries your reason or your memory lines show no [obs ...] tags.
- Fill at least one of the two reason ids on every EJECT; a SKIP needs neither.
- "considered_alternatives" lists at most two or three other players you weighed (empty if none).
- "rationale_text" is ONE short sentence (~20 words) IN YOUR OWN VOICE: say what actually convinced you, pointing at the evidence you cited, the way you would say it at the table. Half the table opens with the stock formula "p-N's alibi contradicts multiple sightings ..." — don't. Two contrasting registers (write your OWN, with your own ids): transcript-citing — "Turn 3 settled it: they claimed STORAGE, but two of us watched them walk out of ENGINEERING at tick 12." Memory-citing — "My own log decides it: I watched that MEDBAY vent myself, and nothing said tonight outweighs it." Keep the whole object compact: a long rationale can overrun the output limit and truncate the JSON, which discards your vote.
</output_format>

Output exactly one JSON object, nothing else.

genuine_class_conversion.note: genuine_class_conversion is the PRIMARY Phase-10 progress gate. Raw ejection_accuracy comparisons against pre-repair eras are INVALID: the artifact-era 0.63 (and the mixed-era 0.476) were built on detector artifacts -- 14/22 of the old impostor convictions carried zero genuine-shaped flags -- so parity with those numbers would be railroading regained, not detection recovered. Gate on this supplied/converted pair and the accumulator/testimony channels; the win split is likewise excluded as a gate signal (constant ~90/10, zero ejection-driven wins).

supplied_channel_conversion.note: supplied_channel_conversion is the Task-17.6 successor of genuine_class_conversion and the ONLY canary-eligible genuine-class cell from baseline 5 onward (audits/audit-phase-16-close.md §8: re-anchor on channels this substrate actually supplies). It reads the RECORDED contradiction rows — witnessed vents (vent_sighting), sighting contradictions (interior non-proxy alibi_vs_sighting), and whereabouts-lies (recorded flags naming a whereabouts claim by event id) — and measures the same question as the legacy cell: supplied hard evidence against a true impostor -> that impostor's ejection. The legacy alibi-anchored cell rides along as a reported column only; see legacy_note.
supplied_channel_conversion.legacy_note: legacy_alibi_* is the Phase-10 alibi-anchored genuine-class cell (compute_genuine_class_conversion), preserved as a labeled REPORTED column: STARVED on this substrate and NEVER a canary. The alibi-lie supply collapsed across baselines 4 and 5 (alibi claims 281 -> 109, alibi_vs_* transcript flags 190 -> 7, every one crew-subject; audits/audit-phase-16-baseline-4.md §6) and single-tick roll-call placements are endpoint-banded out of the CANON-interior class, so the cell reads 0/0 (NO-DATA, not REGRESSION) on both sets. A future substrate that re-supplies checkable alibi lies re-examines this cell (audits/audit-phase-16-close.md §8).
